title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 remote code execution was possible via path traversal in project…
description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in JetBrains TeamCity versions before 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7. The flaw is due to path traversal in project import archives, which could allow an attacker with high privileges to execute arbitrary code remotely. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 7.2 but no known exploits in the wild have been reported. No specific affected versions or patch information is provided in the input data.
